projects.title: UWB State Estimation for Encoderless Field Robots
projects.summary: State-estimation research for field robots without built-in positional measurements, using ultra-wideband antennas and RF sensing.
whatIDid: Developing a state-estimation system for encoderless field robots using ultra-wideband antennas.
Integrating RF sensing, modeling, and hardware testing to estimate joint states and accurate 3D positions.
Building the sensing and validation workflow around robots that do not provide native positional measurements.
results: Established the technical direction for RF-based state estimation on encoderless robotic hardware.
Current work is in active research and test integration.

projects.title: Closed-Loop Antenna Test Automation
projects.summary: Mechanical test hardware, RF measurement automation, and COMSOL modeling for voltage-controlled antenna beam pointing.
whatIDid: Designed antenna test jigs and mounts in SolidWorks, produced technical drawings, and used FEA to verify displacement under compressive loading.
Built Python closed-loop VNA/gimbal software for +/-60 degree azimuth and +/-40 degree elevation antenna scans.
Modeled liquid-crystal dielectric tensors across PCB structures in COMSOL to validate electromagnetic behavior.
Used load analysis and DFM/DFA feedback to evaluate PCB manufacturability and voltage-controlled beam-pointing design changes.
results: Reduced sidelobe noise levels 8-10 dB and improved antenna gain 10-15 dB.
Reduced a 38,000-point Ka-band antenna scan from about 3 hours to about 1 hour.
Verified gain and pointing against 2D radiation patterns.

projects.title: Pulsejet Propane Engine
projects.summary: Design, manufacture, and bench testing of a propane-fueled pulsejet engine with closed-loop propellant delivery.

photos.caption: Bench test configuration for the pulsejet prototype.

whatIDid: Designed, manufactured, and bench-tested a propane-fueled pulsejet engine with a closed-loop propellant delivery system.
Iterated the combustion structure through 6 hot-fire tests and performed failure analysis after each test.
Used ANSYS and COMSOL to model acoustic resonance and pressure antinodes, then translated findings into chamber geometry changes.
results: Achieved bench-test operation while keeping exhaust temperatures under about 600 C.
Used hot-fire test evidence and simulation results to guide combustion chamber refinements.

projects.title: Autonomous Control for Model Rocketry
projects.summary: Embedded control systems for reusable model rockets using thrust vector control, deployable airbrakes, PID logic, and pressure-based altitude sensing.

photos.caption: Reusable rocket integrating TVC and airbrake subsystems.

whatIDid: Designed and flight-tested embedded systems for reusable model rockets using PID and pressure-based altitude sensing.
Integrated thrust vector control and deployable airbrakes for real-time autonomous trajectory correction and altitude control.
Used a 20 Hz Pnut altimeter for telemetry across iterative flight tests.
results: Improved mean altitude error by about 10% across 20+ flights.
Enabled real-time trajectory correction during powered flight through thrust vectoring.
Improved altitude control using combined TVC and airbrake strategies.

projects.title: PointNet Terrain Classification for Robotic Navigation
projects.summary: PointNet-based machine-learning model for terrain classification in robotic navigation workflows.
whatIDid: Developed a PointNet-based ML model for terrain classification in robotic navigation.
Iterated training and evaluation to improve classification performance.
results: Improved terrain classification accuracy from 85% to 92%.

projects.title: Minerva.AI AR Identity Verification Prototype
projects.summary: Identity-verification and information-retrieval prototype for XREAL AR glasses with low-latency model integration.
whatIDid: Built an identity-verification and information-retrieval prototype for XREAL AR glasses using Kotlin and C++.
Integrated OpenAI Whisper and a TensorFlow/Keras Siamese network into the prototype.
Led early product design while engaging strategic stakeholders.
results: Reached under 300 ms latency in the prototype workflow.
Raised $10k in pre-seed funding and engaged stakeholders including IQT.

projects.title: Satellite Orbital and Atmospheric Trajectory Simulation
projects.summary: NASA GMAT simulation work for satellite orbital and atmospheric trajectories to verify mission feasibility and lifespan.
whatIDid: Wrote NASA GMAT scripts to simulate satellite orbital and atmospheric trajectories.
Evaluated trajectory behavior against mission feasibility and lifespan constraints.
Documented assumptions and simulation outputs for mechanical subteam review.
results: Verified mission feasibility and projected lifespan through simulation workflows.

projects.title: Bioelectric Signal Processing for Embedded Rover Control
projects.summary: Embedded system that processes EEG and EMG bioelectric signals to control a mobile robotic platform.

photos.caption: Mobile rover platform used for signal-controlled testing.
Captured EEG and EMG waveforms used for signal characterization.
System integration and testing of signal-driven control logic.

whatIDid: Developed signal-processing logic to extract frequency-domain features from EEG and EMG measurements.
Implemented embedded control mapping between extracted signal features and rover motion states.
Standardized test setup and data collection procedures to improve repeatability.
results: Achieved consistent rover response under controlled test conditions.
Identified transient overshoot behavior and proposed mitigation strategies through control logic refinement.

projects.title: Studdy Buddy Web Application
projects.summary: Full-stack educational web application designed to improve study engagement through interactive game-based review modes.

photos.caption: Web interface showing interactive study modes.

whatIDid: Designed and implemented the full-stack architecture including front end, backend, and database integration.
Developed structured game logic with real-time feedback, scoring, and randomized content generation.
Designed a relational database schema to support scalable content storage and retrieval.
results: Delivered a responsive and reliable study tool with consistent content retrieval and validation.
Improved user engagement through measurable progress tracking and feedback mechanisms.

projects.title: AccelSpin High-Speed Rotational Launcher
projects.summary: Design and fabrication of a high-speed rotational system capable of launching projectiles using stored rotational energy.

photos.caption: Spindle and release mechanism used for projectile deployment.

whatIDid: Designed and fabricated a rotational launcher driven by a high-torque electric motor.
Implemented tunable speed control to adjust launch energy based on projectile mass and target altitude.
Incorporated vibration mitigation and safety constraints for high-speed operation.
results: Achieved repeatable vertical launch trajectories through controlled release timing.
Maintained stable operation up to 1000 RPM following vibration control improvements.

projects.title: Mechanical Impact Mitigation System
projects.summary: Design and validation of a spring-damper impact mitigation system to reduce peak acceleration during drop tests.

photos.caption: Two-layer spring-damper structure used for drop testing.

whatIDid: Designed a two-layer spring-damper system to extend deceleration time and reduce peak impact loads.
Calculated effective stiffness and damping values and modeled expected dynamic response.
Validated performance through physical drop testing under mass and height constraints.
results: Final system mass of 2.14 kg excluding payload.
Measured effective stiffness of 4370 N/m and damping of 480 N per m per s.
Successfully protected payload during repeated drop tests.
